2607.11577.title: Structure-Feature Aligned Graph Learning via Alternating Constrained Optimization
2607.11577.paper_summary: We introduce a constrained two-view framework for node prediction that aligns structure-conditioned GNN embeddings with a structure-free feature prior learned by an anchor model. Conventional Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) couple feature transformation and neighborhood aggregation, which renders them vulnerable to topology noise and heterophilous connections. To decouple this dependency, our framework utilizes an independent anchor network to capture intrinsic attribute features via a self-supervised reconstruction objective. Furthermore, we propose a Channel-Split Adaptive Gated GNN (CSAG-GNN) that dynamically routes representations between global spectral smoothing and local spatial discrimination through a node-wise gating mechanism. We propose a stable cyclic alternating optimization strategy to solve the resulting coupled bi-level objective, preventing mutual representation drift during training. Empirical results on both homophilous and heterophilous benchmarks show balanced performance gains and structural robustness over competitive baselines.
2607.11577.paper_summary_zh: 我們提出了一個受限的雙視圖框架，用於節點預測，該框架將結構條件的 GNN 嵌入與由錨模型學習的無結構特徵先驗對齊。傳統的圖神經網絡（GNN）將特徵轉換和鄰域聚合結合在一起，這使它們容易受到拓撲噪聲和異質連接的影響。為了解耦這種依賴，我們的框架利用獨立的錨網絡通過自我監督重建目標來捕捉內在屬性特徵。此外，我們提出了一種通道分割自適應門控 GNN（CSAG-GNN），該模型通過節點級門控機制在全局光譜平滑和局部空間區分之間動態路由表示。我們提出了一種穩定的循環交替優化策略來解決所產生的耦合雙層目標，防止在訓練過程中互相表示漂移。在同質和異質基準上的實證結果顯示，相較於競爭基準，我們的模型在性能增益和結構穩健性方面均衡表現。
2607.11577.author: Chengcheng Yan et.al.
